mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in GDPC1, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: GDPC1 YoY growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tight labor market that will drive wage inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in higher costs and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: UNRATE drops below 4% but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) growth decelerates by more than 2pp YoY, it signals a potential supply chain disruption that will negatively impact corporate earnings and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO YoY growth decelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) are in a simultaneous YoY decline, it signals a broad-based demand slowdown that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both in YoY decline but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 5% and rising, it signals a restrictive monetary policy that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in slower growth and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS > 5% and rising but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth accelerates by more than 200k jobs per month over a 3-month period, it signals a strengthening labor market that will boost consumer spending and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS 3-month growth > 200k jobs/mo but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) is rising by more than 3% YoY and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a wage-price spiral that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as the market prices in higher inflation and potential Fed tightening.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL YoY > 3% and UNRATE < 5% but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 40% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) are both rising, it signals a tightening of financial conditions that will drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in slower growth and higher borrowing costs.
failure_condition: INDPRO and FEDFUNDS both rising but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
